releaseTitle: ATalk v3.10.4 — Telegram UI/UX & Sensory Ecosystem Upgrades
releaseNotes:
• 01 Telegram-Grade Delivery Status Engine: Strict SENT (single grey check) on weak network/server acceptance, verified DELIVERED (double grey check) on peer receipt, and READ (double blue check) tied strictly to last_read_at watermarks.
• 02 In-App 3-Column Media Picker: High-performance bottom sheet loading camera roll media directly via MediaStore with live camera tile, numbered circular selection badges (1, 2, 3), HD quality toggle, and fallback file manager access.
• 03 Telegram 2D Matrix Reaction Grid & Unboxed Badges: Instant access to top 28 emojis without horizontal scrolling friction, coupled with unboxed inline reaction counters nestled directly beside timestamps.
• 04 Theme & Wallpaper Studio Persistence: Complete persistent storage of custom themes (OLED Midnight, Polar, Emerald, Obsidian, Monokai Cyber, Redshift) and procedural wallpapers across sessions via encrypted VaultManager.
• 05 Notification & Message Sound Studio: Customizable acoustic profiles (Aurora, Crystal Droplet, Cyber Synth, Minimalist Pop) with in-app live audio preview and dynamic Android notification channel binding.
• 06 Kinetic Lightbox & Frosted Acrylic Haze: Fluid pinch-to-zoom and double-tap gestures powered by Saket Telephoto, accompanied by Chris Banes Haze progressive frosted glass acrylic backdrop blurs.
